description: Jira · Features: from every Jira story, draft the product's feature list — features, each with a one-line description, the stories under it and a status roll-up (resources/js/jiraFeatures.js). Draft with AI or auto-group without AI, edit the names, save per project, export to PDF / Excel / HTML.

conn.description: The Jira connection (jiraBacklog): site, project, connected, name.

project.description: The Jira project key the features are saved under ('' = every project).

search.description: Which jiraBacklog search the stories come from (default: All stories).

aiReady.description: Whether an AI is set up (else only auto-group is offered).

draft.description: The current grouping [{ name, description, storyKeys }] — what is saved and edited.

model.description: The built model: features → their stories with roll-ups, and the ungrouped (jiraFeatures.build).

savedAt.description: When the saved feature list was last saved.

dirty.description: The draft changed since it was saved.
